community_list_entries.name: Reconstructing the Right Episode: Evaluating Interleaved Conversational Memory Beyond Long Context

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Introduces SCALE-QA: 3,000 audited 4-way MCQ questions across 10 domains, embedded in flat unsegmented mixed-topic chat threads up to 128k (and 1M diagnostic). Answers depend on earlier latent episodes, with stress cues including state overwrite. The TSIM method is a secondary contribution.
